description: This file contains build rules, device definitions, and macros for the Sercomm devices in a OpenWrt build system. It defines various build processes, offsets, and image packaging procedures specific to different Sercomm hardware configurations.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-append-tail
methods.description: Appends a specific tail pattern to a device image, possibly for firmware formatting.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-crypto
methods.description: Encrypts and signs a device image using a Python script and OpenSSL.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-factory-cpj
methods.description: Builds a factory image for the CPJ device, extracting kernel and root filesystem segments and creating header files.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-factory-cqr
methods.description: Creates a device-specific identifier file with hardware and software info, and constructs a firmware header.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-kernel
methods.description: Creates a kernel header image prepended to the kernel image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-kernel-factory
methods.description: Builds a header for the kernel used during factory image creation.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-mkhash
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash of part of the device image and embeds it into the image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-part-tag
methods.description: Adds a partition tag to a specified file.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-part-tag-common
methods.description: Helper to add partition labels to images.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-payload
methods.description: Constructs a payload with device-specific identifiers and embeds it into the image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-pid-setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the image, likely for flags or configuration bits.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-prepend-tagged-kernel
methods.description: Prepends a partition tag to the kernel image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-reset-slot1-chksum
methods.description: Resets or clears checksum data in a specific slot of the device image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-sysupgrade-cpj
methods.description: Builds a specialized sysupgrade image for the CPJ device including kernel and root filesystem segments.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-kernel-header
methods.description: Creates a kernel header image with specific offsets.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-kernel-factory
methods.description: Creates headers for kernel segments during factory image creation.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-mkhash
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash checksum and embeds it into the image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-part-tag
methods.description: Adds partition tags to images based on provided partition names.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-payload
methods.description: Creates and embeds a device-specific payload segment.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-pid-setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the image for configuration.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-prepend-tagged-kernel
methods.description: Augments the kernel image with a partition tag.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-reset-slot1-chksum
methods.description: Clears or resets a checksum value at a specific location in the image.

methods.name: Build/sercomm-sysupgrade-cpj
methods.description: Builds a comprehensive sysupgrade image for CPJ with kernel and rootfs.
